_guide: HOW TO ADD / EDIT A CONTRIBUTOR
This file is copied to your user data folder on first launch:
From then on the app reads THAT copy, so edit it there — no rebuild needed.
The copy in the repository root is only the default shipped with the app.
Each entry inside "contributors" looks like this:
"description": "Helps with...",     <- short text, keep it in English
"name": "Octo Cat",                 <- optional, shown instead of username
- The order in the file is the order shown in the About screen.
- The avatar is fetched automatically from GitHub by username.
- The description is intentionally neutral English (not translated).
- "name" and "url" can be removed if you do not need them.
- Delete the file in the user data folder to restore the default list.

contributors.description: Created the Android app that VIVI Music DE is based on, and keeps the project — and its developer — in line.
Contributes massively by testing VIVI Music DE on macOS (Apple Silicon) and providing feedback — including technical feedback — across every area of the app.
Always available to help those in need in the Telegram channel, even without a PC.
Created the foundation of the new UX — without him, this would not exist.
